Pattaya Dolphinarium

• Pattaya Dolphinarium is widely considered the number 01 marine mammal show in Asia, featuring world-class performances by South American fur seals and bottlenose dolphins.

• Intelligent dolphins and charming seals will showcase a range of skills, from impressive acrobatics to heartwarming interactions, it will be a truly unforgettable experience for you

• We will pick you up from your Pattaya hotel around 09:00 AM and transfer will begin. You will travel to Coral Island by speedboat.

Pattaya Tiger Park

• At Pattaya Tiger Park, you can view and observe different types of tigers including giant Bengal tigers in a safe and well-managed environment.

• Optional-You can choose to go in the cage (10-15 mins.) to feel, touch, hug and play with tigers.Also you can take pictures with tigers. (these activities are not included in the package)
